care-team.name: ScaleHaven Care Team
care-team.role: Reptile keepers and breeders at ScaleHaven Reptiles
care-team.bio: Our care team raises and looks after every animal we sell, from hatchling to shipping day. We write these guides from the husbandry we use in our own facility, and we review them as best practice evolves. For health concerns, always consult a qualified reptile veterinarian.
